questions.stem: Formative assessment is used primarily to:
choices: Assign a final grade at the end of a course
Monitor learning and give feedback while teaching is still going on
Rank students for a national merit list
questions.explain: Formative assessment is ongoing and aims to improve learning, not only to certify it.

questions.stem: In an experiment, the variable that the researcher deliberately changes is the:
questions.explain: The independent variable is manipulated; the dependent variable is what is measured.

questions.stem: Presenting another author’s words as your own without citation is:
questions.explain: Plagiarism is using someone else’s work without proper acknowledgement.

questions.stem: HTTPS differs from HTTP mainly because it:
choices: Encrypts the connection, typically with TLS
questions.explain: The “S” stands for secure; traffic is encrypted with TLS.

questions.stem: NAAC is an autonomous body that:
choices: Accredits higher education institutions in India
Disburses all research grants of CSIR
Sets the school-leaving syllabus for CBSE
questions.explain: The National Assessment and Accreditation Council assesses and accredits HEIs.

questions.stem: In Bloom’s revised taxonomy, the lowest cognitive level is:
questions.explain: Remember (recall of facts) is the base of the revised taxonomy.

choices: Only loud sounds in a classroom
Any interference that distorts the intended message
questions.explain: Noise is any barrier — physical, semantic, or psychological — that distorts the message.

questions.stem: A sample in research is best described as:
choices: The entire set of people or items of interest
A subset selected from the population for study
questions.explain: The population is the full set; a sample is the portion actually observed.

questions.stem: Which statement about classroom ICT use is most accurate?
choices: ICT automatically improves learning without pedagogy
ICT is a tool whose value depends on how teaching is designed
ICT can replace the need for any learning outcomes
Only desktop computers count as ICT
questions.explain: Technology supports teaching; learning gains depend on design, not the tool alone.
